description: A dwarven miner's pick: a long steel head banded in bronze on an ash haft, balanced so the swing does half the work. It bites through hard rock in one blow.
name: Dwarven Pick
notes: Mining tier 2: two extra swings at every face, hard rock breaks in one strike, and it cuts deepiron.
Forged to order by the Forgemistress in Ironpeak from 10 iron ore and 5 copper ore, for 400 gold.
Wears as you swing it. A worn pick costs you swings; a crafting kit or a smith puts it right.
